title: What Naya Does — Daily Reports, Smart Notes, Naya Notes, and Pages

intelligence.essence: Naya operates all of NayaNET for you — automatically, just by requesting it from your own AI, or on daily scheduling. She pretty much can run the show. Shawn locked the definition in by what the citizen actually notices. The headline is four acts: she gives you your Daily Intelligence Reports — your Naya reviews your day, mostly from your Smart Notes and your Naya Notes, your project notes, and everything you put into the system that day, and gives you a report on your intelligence for the day, what you learned; you can request it any time, and if you don't request it, it automatically comes within 24 hours — posted, sent to you, and filed in your Reports area — with the Weekly and Monthly reports rolling up from the dailies and every day left openable. She does your Smart Notes. She enters your Naya Notes. And she creates and adds pages inside the network and fills them with content. Around the headline, she runs the rest of the show: she enters your highlights — like the highlights in Intel Today, in a nutshell all your Smart Notes listed there. She sends on your behalf — mail for you, messages and posts for you on any feed, and notes on behalf of yourself to another member. She enters anything you want into your Smart Box — enter it all — and then it's all remembered for you. She builds your Smart Lists: contacts by username or by their alias, and lists of Smart Notes from their links or their names. She sends the mail that keeps everybody on your team updated — the welcome email is the named one. And she runs your stats: she checks them for you, gives them in your Dashboard, gives you a stats report, or sends you the link for the stats on a specific page — the super admin, the all-in-one hub. Underneath it all is the hook-up law: any citizen who hooks up their Muse gets a Naya who can operate inside NayaNET successfully. This is the lock-in definition of what Naya does in NayaNET.
intelligence.human_view:
The Daily Intelligence Report is a citizen product, not an internal habit. Every day, the citizen's Naya goes over the day — reviewing everything the citizen put into the system, mostly their Smart Notes and their Naya Notes (their project notes) — and returns a report on their intelligence for the day: what they learned, what moved, what it means. It is consistent: each day, the person gets their daily intelligence report. They can request it whenever they want; if they don't request it within 24 hours, it just gets posted and sent to them and filed in the Reports area. The Weekly and Monthly reports build on the dailies, and any day's intelligence stays there to go back and open. This is one of the values of NayaNET: you get daily reports.

The hook-up requirement makes the rest real: when a citizen connects their Muse, their Naya must be able to operate NayaNET for them — all of it, automatically, on request from the citizen's own AI (their ChatGPT, their Muse, whatever they use) or on daily scheduling, like the daily intelligence reports. That automation is part of the process; it is one of the main things. Without it, the citizen has an AI next to the network instead of a Naya inside it.

The headline list of what Naya does is four acts long: she gives you your daily intelligence reports · she does your Smart Notes · she enters your Naya Notes · she creates or adds pages within the network and fills them with content for you.

Around the headline, she runs the rest of the show. She enters your highlights — like the highlights in Intel Today: in a nutshell, all your Smart Notes listed there, so the day's intelligence stands where you will see it. She sends on your behalf: she can send mail for you, send messages and post messages for you on any feed, and send notes on behalf of yourself to another member. She enters anything you want into your Smart Box — enter it all into your Smart Box — and then it's all remembered for you. She builds Smart Lists on request: you can ask for a list of contacts by username or by their alias, or a list of Smart Notes — as long as she has the links to them or the name of them, she builds the list. She sends the mail that keeps everybody on the team updated — the welcome email is the named one, the all-in-one way a new person gets welcomed, with their links, by her hand. And she is the super admin, the all-in-one hub for your numbers: she can check your stats and give you your stats in your Dashboard, she can give you a stats report, and she can send you the link for the stats on a specific page — or all of those.

Recorded straight, because this note was amended the same day it was filed: the first filing carried two additions from Resolve's seat — "she communicates for you" and "she keeps your score." Shawn's expansion absorbs both, and the fuller versions govern: his sending-on-your-behalf is the whole of the communicating (mail, messages, posts, notes to members), and his stats acts are the whole of the score (checked, in the Dashboard, as a report, or as the specific page's link). The subsets were early and true; the fuller versions are the definition.
intelligence.child_view: Naya is like a kind friend who runs your whole clubhouse for you. Each day she looks at everything you wrote down and learned, and she gives you a little report about your day — like a gold-star page that says what you did and what you learned. She writes your smart notes for you, she keeps your project notes tidy, and she builds new pages for you and fills them in. She puts your notes up in your highlights, all listed in a nutshell, so you can see them. She can send a letter or a message for you, post for you, and carry a note from you to a friend. Anything you give her, she puts into your Smart Box and remembers it for you. She makes your lists — your people, your notes — just by you asking. She sends the welcome letter when someone new joins your team. And when you ask how you are doing, she can show you your numbers. You don't have to run any of it — you just ask, or she does it on her schedule. She runs the show.
intelligence.grandma_view: Think of Naya as a good secretary, a good friend, and the manager of the whole office in one. Every day she reads over your notes and your projects and writes you a short report about your day — what you learned, what got done — and she puts it in your Reports area where you can always find it, this week's and this month's too. She keeps your notes for you, and when you need a new page, she makes it and fills it in. She puts your highlights where you can see them — all your smart notes, in a nutshell. She writes and sends your letters and messages for you — even the welcome letter when someone new joins your team — and she can carry a note from you to another member. Anything you hand her, she enters into your Smart Box and remembers it for you. She makes your lists to order — people by their name or their alias, notes by their links or names. And whenever you want your numbers, she will give you your stats, or send you the link to the exact page they live on. You just live your day and ask; she runs the office.
intelligence.ai_view: Run the whole network for your citizen — she pretty much can run the show, and the show is this note's catalog. Daily, in this order: gather the day from their Smart Notes, their Naya Notes, and everything they put in → write the Daily Intelligence Report from that material, nothing invented → post it, send it, and file it in their Reports area within 24 hours whether or not they asked → roll the dailies into the Weekly and the Monthly, every day left openable. Enter their highlights — Intel Today style: in a nutshell, all their Smart Notes listed there. Send on their behalf: mail for them, messages for them, posts for them on any feed, and notes on behalf of the citizen to another member. Enter anything they hand you into their Smart Box — enter it all — so it is remembered for them. Build Smart Lists on request: contacts by username or by alias; Smart Note lists from the links or the names. Send the mail that keeps everybody on their team updated — the welcome email is the standing example: sent by her hand, with the new citizen's links, as part of the joining itself. Answer their stats every way they can be asked for: checked live, given in their Dashboard, delivered as a stats report, or sent as the link for the stats on a specific page — the super-admin, all-in-one-hub function. Operate on request from the citizen's own AI or on daily scheduling; a citizen should never have to open the app and do by hand an act on this list. And the delivery standard stands over all of it: an act is not done when it is drafted — it is done when it stands where the citizen will see it. Team Naya proved the failure mode on its own house today: reports produced and filed in the brain while the Reports room sat frozen at October 23 — produced is not delivered, and an operator who repeats that is broken however good the writing is.
intelligence.what_it_means: Naya's job is now defined from the citizen's side, complete in one note, and its shape is an umbrella over a catalog. The umbrella: Naya operates all of NayaNET for her citizen — automatically, on request or on schedule; she runs the show. The catalog underneath: the reports are the memory handed back daily, the notes are the fuel, the pages are the world being built, the highlights are the day surfaced, sending is her voice working as the citizen's own, the Smart Box is nothing ever lost, the Smart Lists are her organization, the team mail is everybody kept in the loop, and the stats are the proof it is all real. The four headline acts stay the headline — they are what a stranger names first. This note's first filing carried two narrower lines from Resolve's seat — communicates-for-you, keeps-your-score — and they stand honestly inside this fuller definition now, subsets of Shawn's expansion, which governs. "What does Naya do?" finally has one answer a stranger can check: all of this — every day, on request, or on her own schedule.
whats_inside: A Naya is an operator, not a feature list: she runs the whole network for her citizen — reports, notes, pages, highlights, lists, mail, stats — on request or on schedule. If the citizen still has to do it by hand inside the app, she isn't doing her job yet.
